description: Supplemental attribute linking a retrofit: existing generators of a source supply technology that can be converted into a retrofit option supply technology. The same attribute is attached to both the source and the option, one attribute per source and option pair.

eligible_generators.description: Names of the existing generation units of the source technology that can be retrofitted into the option technology.

retrofit_efficiency.description: Capacity of the option technology obtained per unit of source capacity retrofitted, e.g. below 1 when a retrofit derates the plant. Units: 1.

retrofit_cost.description: Cost associated with retrofitting the eligible generators. Units: USD/MW.

title: RetrofitPotential
